title: Render root-session API error literals containing backticks with valid Markdown code spans
outcome: Literal response examples in the root-session API error table render their internal backticks and placeholder text as one code span.
acceptance: In docs/features/root-coding-sessions.md, error literals containing backticks use double-backtick code-span delimiters with internal literal backticks, so the full response text and angle-bracket placeholders remain visible and formatted as code.
The correction preserves the documented API response text and behavior.
